sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice N.V. Shravan Kumar
 Writ Petition No.6118 of 2020
Order:
Heard Sri M. Mohan Rao, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Government Pleader for Land Acquisition.

2. Aggrieved by the action of the Respondents in interfering with the possession and enjoyment of the petitioner's land admeasuring Ac.5-00 gts., in Sy.No.340/52, situated at Tunki Bollarum village,
Mulugu Mandal, Medak District, presently Siddipet District, without following due process of law the petitioner filed the present Writ Petition.

3. On 20.04.2020 while admitting the Writ Petition in I.A.No.01 of 2020 this Court passed the following order:
"Heard Sri M. Mohan Rao, learned counsel for the petitioner, and learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition.
NVSK,J W.P.No.6118 of 2020 Learned Government Pleader submits that possession would not be taken without following due process of law under the Land Acquisition Act and without paying due compensation as required under Section 38 of Act 30 of 2013.

In that view of the matter, there shall be interim direction as prayed for."
Thereafter no counter has been filed.
In view of the same, orders dated 20.04.2020 passed in I.A.No.01 of 2020 would continue.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner pray this Court to direct the respondent authorities not to interfere with the property of the petitioner without following due process of law.

5. Learned Additional Government Pleader for Land Acquisition submits that the respondent authorities are not interfering with the possession of the petitioner's property and also submits that in case of any acquisition NVSK,J of petitioner's property respondents will follow due process of law.

6. Recording the submissions of both learned counsel and since the order passed on 20.04.2020 in I.A.No.01 of 2020 is still subsisting, without going into the merits of the case, this Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondents to follow due process of law in case of any acquisition of petitioner's property.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
